answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The vault is the serial tenure, the nadir the custody window that must elapse, and the mirror the standing released at the end of it; the vault is personal, the nadir is not skippable, and the mirror cannot be inherited by a sibling.
